YPAA World Tour

Grapevine’s YPAA World Tour features audio stories from YPAA (Young People in AA) members at events around the world. The playlist kicks off with stories by members at the 64th ICYPAA (International Conference of Young People in AA) in Austin, Texas. Stories from more YPAA events will follow!

To Share Your Audio Story

Share as you would in a meeting. Think of a topic such as making amends or finding your first sponsor. Stories should be 6-8 minutes long. If accepted by the AA Grapevine editorial staff, your audio story will be published on the AA Grapevine YouTube channel. 

Two ways to record:

  1. The Audio Project Voicemail System

    •Call the voicemail system at 559-726-1216.
    •Press 1 to hear helpful tips and to begin recording your story after the tone.
    •When finished, press #. You will be prompted to Press 1 to save your story.
    •Press 2 to give AA Grapevine permission to use your story.
     
  2. Do It Yourself

    •Use your own smartphone or other digital recorder (WAV and MP3 files will be accepted.)
    •Send your recording to [email protected].

Note: Grapevine does not collect recordings from speakers at AA meetings.
